newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as financial scrips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as financial scrips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended slightly higher on Wednesday as financial scrips gained amid institutional support and buying by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchage price index rose 2.52 points or 0.21 percent at 1,193.62 on a turnover of 105.7 million taka. Of the 131 issues traded 72 closed up, 53 ended down and six were unchanged.
Leasing company IDLC gained 66.29 taka to 3,175, Bangladesh Lamps rose 107.80 to 3,397.66 and Chittagong Clinker was down 45.51 to 3,122.91.
Brokers said most ICB mutual funds, banks and leasing shares attracted small investors and received institutional support.
